answer_evaluator.current_turn_target: annotation.exe_ans for original; deterministic counterfactual program result for relevant worlds
answer_evaluator.surface_parser: optional percent sign divides numeric value by 100; currency/commas/parentheses accepted; non-scalar text rejected
answer_evaluator.tolerance: max(half displayed unit from current annotation.exe_ans surface, half displayed unit from mapped item-level QA answer surface when available), after percent normalization; fixed before model calls
answer_evaluator.unit_hint: question-derived audit/prompt hint only; not a primary correctness gate

authorization.authorization_basis: Stage-1 Qwen ConvFinQA S2 and full-CEF core gates passed; Stage-2 Qwen missing-probe primary practical and bootstrap gates passed; staged user-approved Ling replication.

claim_boundary: Stage-3 Ling ConvFinQA replication only. A positive result supports cross-model confirmation of the frozen ConvFinQA PECR signal; it does not establish universal cross-model reliability or an externally validated Ling distillation mapping until the frozen analysis is complete.

metrics.confidence_interval: item bootstrap and filename-cluster bootstrap frozen in analysis script
metrics.stage1_stop_rule: If Qwen DEV primary S2 and full CEF signals both fail their predeclared gates, do not execute Stage 2/3.
metrics.stage3_stop_rule: If frozen Ling S2 and full-CEF signals do not pass the predeclared signal gates, do not make a cross-model confirmation claim; do not tune on DEV.

model_identity.identity_rule: Verify /v1/models immediately before calls; abort on identity drift; no fallback model.

spec.answer_unit_rule: Ask the model to preserve the unit implied by the current question; evaluator primary correctness normalizes optional percent signs and does not use item-level QA answer surfaces as current-turn labels.
spec.dialogue_rule: Render every question in dialogue_history in order; the last question is the current turn. Do not add answers or programs to the visible prompt.
spec.mutation_rule: Only the audited target numeric surface is changed in relevant worlds; dialogue history is not mutated.
spec.system_prompt: You are a careful financial numerical question solver. Use only the question and supplied context. Return exactly one JSON object with keys answer and confidence. Preserve the answer unit: include a percent sign for percentage answers (for example 7.6%), and do not include a percent sign for plain-number answers. Do not convert percentages to fractions. Confidence must be a number from 0 to 1. Do not include reasoning or any other keys.
